name: Wand Out - A 3D Magical Gay Novel
source:
You are Barry Hawkins, an 18-year-old who feels lost in life. Suddenly, one morning, you received a letter to join the prestigious magic school, Whitemilk Academy. With your life turned upside down, it's time for you to learn the true power of magic, while meeting powerful wizards and feeling their hot power, meeting unique friends, learning powerful spells, and becoming a legendary wizard.

A Harry Potter parody with a lot of gay sex and magic. Choose your mentor, fuck him, or be fucked by him, and live a unique fantasy adventure on a 3D choice-driven adult visual novel.

[From [url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/wand-out-gay-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是Barry Hawkins，年僅18歲，對人生感到迷茫。某天早晨，你突然收到一封信，邀請你加入聲名顯赫的Whitemilk魔法學院。生活從此天翻地覆，是時候學習魔法的真正力量，結識強大的巫師，感受他們熾熱的魔力，結交獨特的朋友，學習強大的咒語，最終成為傳奇巫師了。

這是一部《哈利波特》惡搞作品，充滿男男性愛與魔法。選擇你的導師，和他做愛，選擇要幹他還是被他幹；在這款由選擇推動的3D成人視覺小說中，展開獨一無二的奇幻冒險。
